extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: four cylinder camshaft, 53 cm long with timing gear, base plate 55 x 13 cm
extras.notes: Single overhead camshaft for an inline four engine: steel shaft with five 44 mm bearing journals and eight cam lobes (exhaust and intake per cylinder, firing order 1-3-4-2, 10.5 mm lift), brass timing gear (module 2.5, 36 teeth) with centre bolt and washer. The shaft ends rest in two painted pillow block bearings on a base plate. Rotating part: 'rotor' (shaft, lobes and gear, axis X), origin on the axis.

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
